method: Read current working-tree source only. No device, traffic or private evidence was accessed. HEAD identifies the baseline, not a guarantee of a clean working tree.
scope: Current Android Play implementation only; no experimental Gold or iOS parity inferred.

references.claim: DNS-only route, IPv6 bypass, DNS request capture; stored bytes are DNS request size, not app traffic volume.
Allowed DNS requests leave the device through protected sockets to upstream resolvers; blocked DNS gets a local response. Network resolver discovery and fallback exist.
Optional Usage Access and unknown screen-state handling; no proof that a tracker fired.
Local storage includes DNS observations, attribution and notes. Data-model comments mentioning SNI and total byte-like fields are not evidence of current Play all-traffic capture.
Retention windows, row cap and latest-per-app sampling exception; cleanup on launch and during monitoring; aggregates persist until explicit erasure.
Erase history preserves active choices/dismissals; reset also clears rules, dismissals and Play address rules; caches/questions cleared. These controls are not a full Android settings reset.
Explicit confirmed browser search sends selected main domain to DuckDuckGo; copying places full selected host on OS clipboard.
Feedback email may prefill app/Android version and device manufacturer/model; company privacy requests open email or external privacy page; Google Play review flow is present.
Backup disabled; extraction exclusions cover app root for cloud backup and transfer.
Notifications created locally; immediate anomaly notifications are not a Play feature. Reports/questions select device-side engines.

limits: No subscriptions, app accounts or developer analytics backend were verified. Do not invent billing or account processing.
Source inspection is not a network audit, release-binary attestation or screen-reader evaluation.
GitHub Pages is an external host: browser requests and host processing are distinct from app-local processing. No hosting retention assurances are made.
All policy text awaits owner/legal review; all non-English translations also await native-speaker review. No legal precedence is assigned.
No commit, push or deployment was performed.
